physical.title: album; painting; papercut
physical.summary:
Portrait of a royal companion, Aqa Larees; painting mounted onto an album folio, B side. Figure is standing looking to left of page, holding his hands clasped before him. He has a moustache and stubble on his chin and wears a hat with a long tail that rises high above his head and trails down his back. Découpage cypresses to either side of the portrait.  Inscribed. Album contains sixty folios  with fifty-nine  paintings   of  figures, and additional découpages, including  floral and vegetal   decoration  in  some margins.

								  Ink and opaque  watercolour, with  découpage on paper. Album covered with   green leather.
